answer: Latency Fingerprint Bridge. Each identity must answer randomized timing challenges routed through a shared bridge node; responses are checked against a per-agent latency profile. A duplicate spun up on the same host inherits the host's profile, which acts like a prism splitting signals the operator can't recombine. Residual correlations surface against a karst-like baseline of network noise, flagging clones. Cost: attackers must provision genuinely distinct hardware and network paths per identity, roughly one full host and unique uplink each.
